name: ENVIRONMENT: INSTALLATION OF SOLAR PANELS AND ELECTRICAL APPLIANCES
description: The project is an initiative that stems from the need identified in the needs assessment carried out by our committee in 2025, the idea is to install solar panels for the generation of electrical energy in homes that are owned by workers, helping to avoid environmental wear and tear by generating clean and renewable energy and providing appliances such as pots, heaters, air fryers, induction stoves, and others to gradually migrate to electrical energy from solar panels and eliminate the use of gas or wood burning appliances, thereby reducing the carbon footprint generated by all workers' homes within the scope of the certificate. The project will be funded 100% with the premium received by our committee.
reason: The results of the needs assessment showed that our workers and their families cook using mainly LP gas and this represents an expense that seriously impacts their economy when, without warning, they run out of gas to continue cooking and have to buy it overnight. In addition, as a second source of energy for cooking, many families use firewood, which when burned pollutes the atmosphere and increases the risk of families suffering respiratory diseases when they inhale the smoke that is generated. That is why there is a need for workers' homes to migrate and start using clean and renewable energies that do not cause pollution, seeking to make homes self-sustainable first by generating their own electricity and then equipping them with devices that work based on this electricity to meet the most basic needs such as electricity, hot water, cooking, etc.
